channel.title: US Top News and Analysis

item.title: Dow rallies 600 points, Nasdaq soars nearly 3% in tech-fueled recovery: Live updates
item.description: Investors were digesting megacap tech earnings and the Federal Reserve's decision to hold rates steady.

item.title: AI investor Leopold Aschenbrenner forced to unwind all public stock positions after steep losses, sources say
item.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund has sold all of its public stock holdings, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Jersey Mike's stock falls 3% in public market debut after pricing shares at $23
item.description: Jersey Mike's priced its initial public offering at $23 per share.

item.title: China’s open-weight model lead exposes America’s AI blind spot
item.description: The future of AI may be dictated not by who builds the smartest model, but who builds the models everyone runs on. Right now, that's China.

item.title: Apple and Amazon report after the bell. Here's what the options market is saying
item.description: Earnings on deck this afternoon for Apple and Amazon will likely decide if the stock market can end what’s so far been a rough week on solid footing.

item.description: Apple reports its third-quarter earnings on Thursday, July 30, after the closing bell. The conference call with analysts is scheduled for 5 p.m. ET.

item.title: Trump says sanctions bill should include tariffs on Iran, despite 'trivial' trade with U.S.
item.description: Trump said he'd "like to see tariffs on Iran" added to a bill that would impose economic sanctions on Russia and those supporting its war against Ukraine.

item.title: McDonald's charts are starting to coil in the direction of a buy signal, Jay Woods says
item.description: Given low volatility on earnings day, a good support area and the fundamental story changing in much of the sector, McDonald's may be worth a quick stop.

item.title: OpenAI cuts prices for two of its GPT-5.6 AI models as companies grow sensitive to costs
item.description: The company is facing pressure to cater to a more cost-sensitive customer base.

item.title: UEFA threatens World Cup boycott over FIFA private equity investment plan
item.description: FIFA has faced backlash from global soccer governing bodies over the proposal to allow private investment.

item.title: Trump promised a 'golden age' for agriculture. Farmers in Iowa say they're still waiting
item.description: President Donald Trump has promised a "golden age" for agriculture, but farmers in Iowa and elsewhere are struggling with tariffs and the Iran war.

item.title: Analysis: Fed Chairman Warsh's credibility in question after leaving interest rates unchanged
item.description: The Fed held interest rates steady, but long-term Treasury yields jumped. Investors are questioning whether he will act forcefully enough on inflation.

item.title: 'The Odyssey' extends stay in 70mm IMAX theaters as shows sell out weeks in advance
item.description: Universal and IMAX have extended the availability of 70mm screenings of Christopher Nolan's retelling of Homer's epic into mid-September.

item.title: The number of stocks trading above a key technical level hit a peak not seen in two years
item.description: The large portion of names trading above that level suggests investors are putting money to work in stocks other those tied to the artificial intelligence trade.

item.title: Retailer Reformation opens flat in NYSE debut as CEO says company is 'ready to scale'
item.description: Retailer Reformation made its IPO on the New York Stock Exchange on Thursday under the ticker symbol "REF."

item.title: U.S. economy slowed to 1.5% growth rate in Q2; June core inflation at 3.3%
item.description: While the GDP number was below expectations, the miss appeared to come from a decline in federal government spending and inventories.

item.title: Amazon on deck to report earnings after the bell with cloud, capex in focus
item.description: Amazon projected its 2026 capex will reach $200 billion, and some analysts believe the total could rise in the face of surging artificial intelligence demand.

item.title: New details in the OpenAI Hugging Face hack show how far agents will go: 'It's now remarkably easy'
item.description: OpenAI's rogue models used publicly exposed credentials across "four accounts on four services" to help facilitate the Hugging Face breach.

item.title: Trump floats pulling Blanche's AG nomination until after GOP holdouts leave office
item.description: The Senate Judiciary Committee, which includes Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis, postponed a vote on advancing Todd Blanche's AG nomination.

item.description: Situational Awareness — a buzzy hedge fund founded by a former OpenAI researcher — is not the only in one in hot water, Jim Cramer said Thursday.

item.description: The exemption allows Zoox to operate up to 2,500 vehicles annually for two years, subject to "enhanced, adaptable" oversight conditions.

item.title: Egypt says drone hit two ships at Mediterranean port as attacks on energy infrastructure widen
item.description: The unclaimed attack comes as Iran, its Houthi alllies in Yemen and Iraqi militias have widened strikes on energy infrastructure across the region.
